## Summary / 摘要

Describe the problem this pull request solves and the reader outcome it improves.  
请说明本次修改解决的问题，以及它将如何改善读者体验或实战价值。

## Change type / 修改类型

- [ ] Factual correction / 事实纠正
- [ ] New or revised field practice / 新增或修订实战方法
- [ ] Original framework improvement / 原创框架改进
- [ ] Template or worked example / 模板或完整示例
- [ ] Official source or open-source resource / 官方来源或开源资源
- [ ] English / Chinese translation / 中英文翻译
- [ ] Repository maintenance / 仓库维护

## Evidence and provenance / 证据与来源

Separate a source's direct claim from your own synthesis. Prefer first-party, publicly accessible evidence for claims about a named organization.  
请区分来源中的直接陈述与个人归纳。涉及具体机构时，优先采用公开的一手资料。

| Claim or changed section / 论点或修改章节 | Source URL or field evidence / 来源或一线证据 | Source date and access date / 发布及访问日期 | Direct claim or inference / 直接陈述或推断 |
|---|---|---|---|
| | | | |

## Content classification / 内容分类

Check every classification that applies.

- [ ] Primary-source summary / 一手来源摘要
- [ ] Author or contributor synthesis / 作者或贡献者归纳
- [ ] Public case study / 公开案例
- [ ] Anonymized case study with sharing authority / 经授权的匿名案例
- [ ] Explicitly illustrative or fictional example / 明确标注的示例或虚构案例
- [ ] Reusable template / 可复用模板

If the change includes a case study, explain who authorized publication, what was anonymized, and which metrics are measured rather than estimated.  
如果包含案例，请说明发布授权、匿名化范围，以及哪些指标是实测而非估算。

## Bilingual status / 双语状态

- [ ] English and Chinese counterparts are both updated and meaning-equivalent.
- [ ] English only; add the `translation-needed` label.
- [ ] Chinese only; add the `translation-needed` label.
- [ ] No user-facing prose changed.

List the counterpart paths and note any intentional localization rather than literal translation.  
请列出对应的中英文文件路径，并说明为适应本地语境而做的非直译调整。

## Original frameworks / 原创框架

- [ ] This change does not alter the FIELD Framework or FDE Delivery Maturity Model.
- [ ] This change improves an original framework while preserving attribution to Bosheng Ding and does not present it as an industry standard.

## Safety, confidentiality, and rights / 安全、保密与权利

- [ ] No confidential customer information, personal data, credentials, private traces, or NDA-covered interview content is included.
- [ ] I have permission to share every non-public artifact or field example included here.
- [ ] External text is summarized in original language; quotations are short, necessary, and attributed.
- [ ] Linked code, datasets, and media have compatible licenses, and their original licenses remain clear.
- [ ] AI assistance, if used materially, was reviewed for accuracy, confidentiality, and attribution by a human contributor.

## Quality check / 质量检查

- [ ] Links resolve and point to the most authoritative available source.
- [ ] Dates, names, role titles, numbers, and code have been checked.
- [ ] Examples distinguish observed facts, assumptions, and recommendations.
- [ ] Markdown tables, relative links, headings, and Mermaid diagrams render on GitHub.
- [ ] The change is focused; unrelated edits are excluded.
- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under CC BY 4.0.

## Reviewer focus / 希望评审重点关注

Call out uncertain claims, trade-offs, translation choices, or sections that deserve domain review.  
请指出不确定的论点、关键取舍、翻译选择，或需要领域专家重点评审的部分。
